```{r rams-taxonomy-exploration, echo=TRUE}
# Exploratory summary of phylum/class diversity in RAMS SO greenlist
# Run this first to inform target group binning decisions

so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, phylum, class) %>%
  count(phylum, class) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, phylum, class, order) %>%
  count(phylum, class, order) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)


# Exploratory summary of phylum/class/family diversity in RAMS SO greenlist
# Run this first to inform target group binning decisions --> 

so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, phylum, class, order, family) %>%
  count(phylum, class, order, family) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

```

```{r rams-target-groups, echo=TRUE}
# Assign target groups based on phylum and class
# Ecologically important SO groups kept separate, remainder collapsed

so_RAMS_list <- so_RAMS_list %>%
  mutate(
    theme_groups = case_when(
      # Vertebrates
      phylum == "Chordata" & class %in% c("Actinopteri",
                                           "Chondrichthyes",
                                           "Hyperoartia",
                                           "Myxini")            ~ "Fish",
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Mammalia"                 ~ "Mammalia",
      phylum == "Chordata" & class == "Aves"                     ~ "Birds",
      phylum == "Chordata" & class %in% c("Ascidiacea",
                                           "Thaliacea",
                                           "Appendicularia")     ~ "Tunicata",
      phylum == "Chordata"                                        ~ "Chordata_Other",

      # Major SO invertebrate phyla
      phylum == "Arthropoda" & class %in% c("Malacostraca",
                                           	"Ostracoda", 
                                           "Hexactinellida",
                                           "Thecostraca",
                                           "Hexanauplia") ~ "Crustaceans_Arthropoda",
      phylum == "Arthropoda" & class =="Pycnogonida"  ~ "SeaSpiders_Arthropoda",
      phylum == "Mollusca"                                        ~ "Mollusca",
      phylum == "Echinodermata"                                   ~ "Echinodermata",
      phylum == "Annelida"                                        ~ "Annelida",
      phylum == "Porifera"                                        ~ "Porifera",
      phylum == "Cnidaria"                                        ~ "Cnidaria",
      phylum == "Bryozoa"                                         ~ "Bryozoa",
      phylum == "Nematoda"                                        ~ "Nematoda",
      phylum == "Platyhelminthes"                                 ~ "Platyhelminthes",

      # Important SO protist groups
      phylum == "Foraminifera"                                    ~ "Foraminifera",
      phylum == "Bacillariophyta"                                 ~ "Diatoms",
      phylum == "Ciliophora"                                      ~ "Ciliophora",

      # Smaller but real SO groups collapsed
      phylum %in% c("Chaetognatha", "Brachiopoda", "Nemertea",
                    "Kinorhyncha", "Acanthocephala",
                    "Ctenophora", "Hemichordata")                 ~ "Minor_Invertebrates",

      # Fungi and plants
      phylum %in% c("Ascomycota", "Basidiomycota")               ~ "Fungi",
      phylum %in% c("Streptophyta", "Rhodophyta","Haptophyta", "Chlorophyta")           ~ "Plants_Algae",

      TRUE                                                        ~ "Other"
    )
  )

cat("RAMS target group breakdown:\n")
print(table(so_RAMS_list$theme_groups, useNA = "always"))
```

```{r rams-target-groups-barplot, echo=TRUE}
# Bar chart — unique taxa per target group

so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, theme_groups) %>%
  count(theme_groups, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(theme_groups = fct_reorder(theme_groups, n)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = theme_groups, y = n, fill = theme_groups)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "RAMS Southern Ocean Greenlist — Taxa per Target Group",
      x     = "Target Group",
      y     = "Number of Taxa"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10))
```


```{r rams-Family-barplot, echo=TRUE}
# Bar chart — unique taxa per target group

so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, order) %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = order, y = n, fill = order)) +
    geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
   # geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
    coord_flip() +

      title = "RAMS Southern Ocean Greenlist — Taxa per Target Group",
      x     = "Target Group",
      y     = "Number of Taxa"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 0))
```

```{r rams-target-groups-donut, echo=TRUE}
# Donut chart — proportional composition of RAMS greenlist target groups

rams_donut_data <- so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, theme_groups) %>%
  count(theme_groups, name = "n") %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  mutate(
    pct          = n / sum(n),
    theme_groups = fct_reorder(theme_groups, n),
    label        = ifelse(
      pct * 100 >= 2,
      paste0(theme_groups, "\n", n,
             " (", scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), ")"),
      ""
    )
  )

ggplot(rams_donut_data, aes(x = 2, y = n, fill = theme_groups)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = 2.6, label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  xlim(0.5, 3.2) +
  labs(title = "RAMS Southern Ocean greenlist — Target Group Composition") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```



```{r rams-target-groups-stacked, echo=TRUE}
# Stacked bar — class breakdown within each target group

so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, theme_groups, order) %>%
  count(theme_groups, order) %>%
  mutate(theme_groups = fct_reorder(theme_groups, n, sum)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = theme_groups, y = n, fill = order)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "RAMS greenlist — Order Breakdown within Target Groups",
      x     = "Target Group",
      y     = "Number of Taxa",
      fill  = "Class"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )

### also look by family 
so_RAMS_list %>%
  distinct(tax_id, theme_groups, family) %>%
  count(theme_groups, family) %>%
  mutate(theme_groups = fct_reorder(theme_groups, n, sum)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = theme_groups, y = n, fill = family)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "RAMS greenlist — family Breakdown within Target Groups",
      x     = "Target Group",
      y     = "Number of Taxa",
      fill  = "Class"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm")
    )
```
